name: Traditional Rangoli / Muggulu Competition
description: Showcase your creativity using pure rice powder, natural pigments, turmeric, and flowers. Themes strictly centered on Lord Vinayaka, temple motifs, and Indian folklore.

name: Modak & Traditional Sweet Making Contest
description: Craft exquisite sweet recipes from Ukadiche Modak to Bellam Kudumulu, Undrallu, and Kajjikayalu. Judged on divine authenticity, flavor, presentation, and hygiene.

name: Devotional Singing & Stotram Recitation
description: Recite Sankata Nashana Ganesha Stotram, Ganesha Ashtakam, or render Carnatic and devotional songs honoring Vighneshwara. Evaluated on pronunciation, shruti, and devotion.

name: Clay Ganesha Sculpting for Children
description: Encouraging young minds to craft eco-friendly natural clay Vinayaka idols with embedded floral seeds. Free clay and sculpting tools provided.
